Rows no separators? 9 rows = 3 row-blocks (R=3). Each cell within 3x3 block is either all? Actually each row within a 3-row block and within a 3-col block forms 3x3 tile. Values are 2 or 0, likely each 3x3 tile represents a binary cell? Looking at input row groups: Each 3x3 tile is either all 2s (for symbol maybe 1) or pattern with center 0? Let's inspect.

row0 222, row1 202, row2 222 => has center 0 -> pattern "O"? block3 rows0-2 cols8-10: row0 222,row1 202,row2 222. block4 all 222. So top row of meta-grid: [solid, O, O, solid].
